title: Your First 24 Hours in Hangzhou, Dealt as Cards
description: A ten-card day moving from West Lake’s composed landscape through tea, Buddhism, silk, medicine, Southern Song memory, and the contemporary Qiantang riverfront.

cards.title: West Lake Cultural Landscape
cards.subtitle: Role: read the city’s landscape grammar
cards.notes: Begin beside the water and notice the deliberate composition: lake, causeways, islands, bridges, temples, and wooded hills. UNESCO describes West Lake as a cultural landscape shaped over centuries, so this first card supplies the visual vocabulary for the day.
cards.short_summary: Start with the designed relationship between water, hills, architecture, and the city.
cards.source_title: West Lake Cultural Landscape of Hangzhou - UNESCO World Heritage Centre

cards.title: China National Tea Museum, Shuangfeng
cards.subtitle: Role: learn what is inside the cup
cards.notes: Use the Shuangfeng campus to establish a practical foundation in tea culture before entering Hangzhou’s tea-growing landscape. The museum identifies this as its original campus and gives the exact address as 88 Longjing Road.
cards.short_summary: Set the day’s tea context at the museum’s original Shuangfeng campus.
cards.source_title: Basic Introduction - China National Tea Museum

cards.title: Lingyin Temple
cards.subtitle: Role: enter Hangzhou’s Buddhist history
cards.notes: Shift from tea fields to the wooded religious landscape northwest of West Lake. Lingyin Temple’s own history places its foundation in the Eastern Jin era and explains how the present monastery emerged from a much larger early group of temples.
cards.short_summary: Meet the city’s long Buddhist thread in its mountain setting.

cards.title: Lou Wai Lou
cards.subtitle: Role: make lunch part of the lakeshore story
cards.notes: Return to Gushan for a meal in a restaurant founded in 1848. The venue’s account connects its cooking philosophy—fresh, live, and tender ingredients—with its position at the foot of Gushan beside West Lake; choose from the available menu rather than arriving with a single prescribed dish.
cards.short_summary: Pause for lunch at a long-established restaurant woven into the Gushan lakeshore.
cards.source_title: Lou Wai Lou - Hangzhou Where Tradition Meets Innovation

cards.title: Xiling Seal Art Society
cards.subtitle: Role: decode a small but consequential art form
cards.notes: Stay on Gushan and look closely at how carved seals join script, image, and authorship. Founded in 1904, the society is an academic organization devoted to seal carving, with its headquarters on the western side of the hill.
cards.short_summary: Follow Chinese visual culture down to the scale of a carved seal.
cards.source_title: Hangzhou Asian Games Historic and Cultural Experience Centers: Xiling Seal Art Society

cards.title: China National Silk Museum
cards.subtitle: Role: trace material from fiber to fashion
cards.notes: Continue around the lake to a museum whose remit begins with Chinese silk and expands into costume, traditional craft, textile conservation, and contemporary fashion. That range makes this a material-history stop rather than a shopping detour.
cards.short_summary: See silk as technology, clothing, conservation work, and living design.

cards.entity_name: Hu Qingyu Hall Chinese Traditional Herbal Medicine Museum
cards.title: Hu Qingyu Hall Chinese Traditional Herbal Medicine Museum
cards.subtitle: Role: inspect a working tradition through its objects
cards.notes: At 95 Dajing Lane, move from textiles to materia medica. The exhibits introduce Chinese herbal medicine through specimens, ancient workshops, and the history of Hu Qingyu Hall, founded in 1874.
cards.short_summary: Use specimens and workshop spaces to examine Hangzhou’s traditional-medicine heritage.
cards.source_title: Hu Qingyu Hall Chinese Traditional Herbal Medicine Museum

cards.entity_name: Deshou Palace Ruins Museum of the Southern Song Dynasty
cards.title: Deshou Palace Ruins Museum of the Southern Song Dynasty
cards.subtitle: Role: place the Southern Song court underfoot
cards.notes: Turn from commercial history to the city’s former imperial life. Deshou Palace became the retirement residence of emperors Gaozong and Xiaozong; the museum presents excavated remains alongside displays about the period’s architecture and culture.
cards.short_summary: Connect present-day Hangzhou to the excavated footprint of a Southern Song palace.
cards.source_title: Palace Turned Museum to Unveil Southern Song Culture in Hangzhou

cards.title: Qinghefang Historic Street
cards.subtitle: Role: read the old commercial city at street level
cards.notes: Let the day loosen into a pedestrian stroll. Qinghefang served as a commercial and residential center during the Southern Song, and its restored traditional businesses include fan, scissors, pharmacy, and restaurant names—use the surviving shopfront mix as evidence of the district’s mercantile identity.
cards.short_summary: Walk through the trades and storefronts of Hangzhou’s historic commercial quarter.

cards.title: Hangzhou City Balcony
cards.subtitle: Role: finish with the city facing forward
cards.notes: End on the Qiantang River rather than circling back to the lake. The City Balcony is an open urban park in Qianjiang New City, paired in the official account with a planning exhibition about Hangzhou’s history, urban construction, and future development.
cards.short_summary: Close the sequence at the riverfront edge of contemporary Hangzhou.
cards.source_title: Hangzhou City Planning Exhibition Hall and City Balconies
